coverage_entries.source_ref: 年金的給付與申領／未支領之年金餘額
conditions: 保證期間內通常不論被保險人生存與否均保證給付。
提前給付時，貼現利率依計算年金金額所採用之預定利率。

records.review_note: Approved exact TII policy terms match for the remaining 8 tii-life-126 investment-linked variable annuity account-value schedules. Review checked product_id + source_file + source_document_sha256 with zero missing files and zero hash mismatches. Direct PDF concept scan used Unicode NFKC normalization and confirmed annuity payment, annuity amount, investment account/policy value wording, assumed interest rate, annuity life table, and unpaid annuity balance. These versions use policy value / investment account value wording rather than policy account value, but the terms define the same account-value basis. Actual annuity payout remains formula-based and requires user policy/investment account value, annuity start state, selected guarantee period/payment frequency, assumed interest rate, and insurer annuity factors.
records.selection_guidance: 請輸入或確認年金給付開始日時的保單帳戶價值，並依保單首頁確認年金給付開始日、保證期間與給付方式；系統可整理條款公式，但實際年金需依保險公司年金生命表與預定利率換算。

coverage_entries.name: 年金給付
coverage_entries.note: 被保險人於年金給付開始日後仍生存且契約有效時，依條款計算並給付年金金額。
coverage_entries.source_ref: 年金金額的計算／年金給付
conditions: 年金金額需依年金給付開始日時之保單帳戶價值、預定利率及年金生命表計算。
實際年金金額需依保單首頁約定之年金給付開始日、保證期間及給付方式確認。
條款載明保證期間選項為 10 年。

coverage_entries.name: 返還保單帳戶價值
coverage_entries.note: 被保險人於年金給付開始日前身故時，依條款返還保單帳戶價值。
coverage_entries.source_ref: 被保險人身故的通知與返還保單帳戶價值
conditions: 保單帳戶價值需依條款指定之申領文件收齊日、資產評價日、匯率及未還款項計算。
給付後契約效力終止。
